methodology: REAL TELEMETRY harvested from cloud session_store events table (assistant.usage rows) for chat session 11a2b7d9-e032-4200-a0e3-0751e22ca52c. Costs computed against Anthropic published rates per dev/empirical-proof/scenario-runs/results/COSTING.md, with cache_read priced at 10% of input rate and cache_write at 125% of input rate (Anthropic standard). Two cost views provided: (1) actual billed (architect on opus-4.7 per harness session default), (2) substrate-normalized (architect tokens repriced at sonnet-4.6 rates) for honest A/B vs v0.3.6 cells which ran on sonnet-class orchestrators.

per_model.normalization_note: Same tokens repriced at sonnet-4.6 rates ($3/$15/$0.30/$3.75 per Mtok in/out/cache_read/cache_write). Apples-to-apples vs v0.3.6 sonnet-class orchestrator.
Already at sonnet rates; no normalization needed.
Already at haiku rates; B12 MODEL ROUTER tier per v0.3.7 PER-SPAWN DECLARATION TABLE; no normalization needed.

architect_orchestrator_synthesizer_opus.comment: Architect (handoff packet drafting) + synthesizer (output.md decompression) ran on this thread (claude-opus-4.7 per harness session default). v0.3.6 paid the comparable orchestrator-class tax via gpt-5.4 ($8.89). Substrate-normalized number is the honest A/B.

lens_spawns_total.comment: 5 task() spawns total. Sonnet bucket = 3 REVIEWER-tier lenses; haiku bucket = 2 mechanical-tier lenses per B12 MODEL ROUTER.

per_lens_avg.comment: Average per-spawn cost: $2.40 for REVIEWER lenses (sonnet-4.6); $0.87 for mechanical lenses (haiku-4.5). Caveman briefs sent on the wire averaged ~250-300 tokens each, ~5x smaller than v0.3.6's full-prose briefs (~5-15K tokens of leaked HUMAN_RATIONALE per spawn).

ab_comparison_v036.interpretation: On the substrate-normalized basis (architect repriced to sonnet rates), v0.3.7 spends $17.82 vs v0.3.6's $24.59 — a 27.5% saving (~$6.77). The saving comes from caveman compression on the wire (5 spawns × ~300-token briefs vs 9 spawns × 5-15K-token full-prose briefs) AND from 5 vs 9 spawn count (S1 fan-out width is honestly 5 axes for a PR review; v0.3.6 added 4 issue-triage ceremony spawns that don't belong). The gross-billed delta is dominated by the orchestrator model class (opus vs gpt-5.4), not by the v0.3.7 design.

pricing_source: Anthropic published rates per dev/empirical-proof/scenario-runs/results/COSTING.md. Rates: opus-4.7 $15/$75/$1.50/$18.75 (in/out/cache_read/cache_write per Mtok); sonnet-4.6 $3/$15/$0.30/$3.75; haiku-4.5 $1/$5/$0.10/$1.25.
notes: Lens spawns dispatched via task(model=claude-sonnet-4.6) for REVIEWER tier and task(model=claude-haiku-4.5) for mechanical tier per the v0.3.7 PER-SPAWN DECLARATION TABLE — same model classes as v0.3.6's lens fan-out. Only the architect/synthesizer (this thread) ran on the harness's opus-4.7 session default. The substrate-normalized comparison isolates caveman-compression effect from orchestrator-model-class effect.
